proposed_threshold.logic: CI gate: every walk clip x direction cell's max pair ratio must stay under the value; INF (churn with no motion) always fails. Value = smallest round number >= 1.25 x arm-3's worst observed walk cell, checked to sit below arm-1's worst cell so a regression to per-frame decisions + unsnapped renders trips the gate; arm-1's typical cell is below the gate (backstop, not detector)
